notes:
Dahu 0.98.0 beta for Windows

Changes since 0.97.0:
- Removed the old 2,000-object ceiling from imports, native project reopening and ordinary batch editing.
- Removed fixed quotas for layers, groups, block definitions and selection sets; more efficient selection of large groups.
- Closed dropdown labels and arrows are vertically aligned, including World and document units.
- Removed the footer navigation icon. Concise controls are available in Preferences > Navigation > Controls.
- New grids default to 10 lines per side; saved document settings are preserved.

Per-command calculation limits remain, such as 500 new objects per Array action. Loading large documents is still subject to available memory and format/geometry constraints. The Dell XPS 15 9520 4K performance investigation remains open.

Validation: 148 workflow checks, including STEP above 24 MiB with 2,105 objects; 3DM/DXF/3MF above 2,000 objects; DXF/native projects above 1,000 layers; batch editing, Undo and failed-import atomicity. Native Windows desktop and updater checks passed, including rejection of altered signatures.

Includes the Windows installer, updater signature and corresponding AGPL source archive. The installer is not Authenticode-signed.
